title: Patch-identified neuron localization under channel degradation
disposition_reason: Complete 880-case scoring/projection and a real geometry-centroid negative-control producer are delivered. The target is explicitly a nearest-contact location proxy, and the centroid is not a competent waveform method. Authentic normalizer/units/animal joins and target-independent COM/triangulation/grid-convolution references remain missing.

scientific_target.question: Can multichannel extracellular waveforms localize a patch-identified source near its approximate spatial reference under the complete fixed channel-degradation trajectory?
scientific_target.known_answer: Two-coordinate nearest-contact spatial proxy in verified probe-plane micrometres; strict Euclidean error < 50 µm is the registered accuracy convention, not known ground-truth precision.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Patch-identified spike correspondence and independently qualified source spatial workbook/index mapping. Current scorer requires reference_kind=nearest_contact_proxy.
scientific_target.case_unit: A selected cell×degradation condition×noise realization with every requested spike/template row.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Verified animal with cells/recordings nested; 11 selected paired cells are not assumed 11 animals.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Localization of identified spike sources and robustness to artificial noise; absolute proxy accuracy and estimator stability are separate quantities.
exclusions: Spike detection or exact biological soma coordinates.
Genuine in-vivo motion from drift relative to own undegraded estimate.
All 43 source pairs, population generalization or authentic chronic electrode failure.

inputs: Admitted complete multichannel waveforms/templates, probe geometry with ordered axes in µm, sampling/voltage units and permitted support masks.
Every requested spike/template across 11 cells×16 conditions×5 realizations; identical geometry and source support across methods.
forbidden_inputs: Reference coordinates, patch/probe calibration that reveals them, answer-bearing source IDs or notebook outputs.
Private noise masks/seeds in the unknown-mask condition; target-conditioned retries.
observation_contract.case_identity: Normalized manifest supplies opaque case_id/request_id/condition IDs and authenticated artifact hashes; 880 complete cases and all requested rows are validated. Actual original waveform/channel/animal joins remain external.
observation_contract.split: Keep full cell degradation trajectory together; group repeated recordings and verified animal overlaps. Proposed grouped development/test split is not a random spike split and must be frozen after authentic animal joins.
observation_contract.coverage: Delivered scorer/control enforce 880 logical cases and every spike/template request. This is selected 11-pair support; native payload and complete source-normalizer qualification are not established.

primary.name: Group-balanced spike localization accuracy at strict error < 50 µm
primary.aggregation: All requested spikes per cell/condition, equal cells within recording, recordings within animal, animals within condition, then equal conditions. Templates scored separately.
primary.rationale: Prevents many spikes or cells from one animal dominating and separates approximate absolute accuracy from trivially stable estimates.

secondary: All 16 condition degradation curves and every independent group result.
Continuous cell/condition median error and hierarchical summary.
Template absolute accuracy/error separately and stability against own undegraded template.
Complete support/failure ledger and resource use.

comparators.name: Geometry centroid negative control
comparators.inputs: All probe contact coordinates only; no waveforms, masks or target bodies.
comparators.procedure: Delivered producer takes arithmetic mean of all contacts and emits same estimate for every request. A fixed, stable floor, explicitly not a competent waveform baseline.

comparators.name: COM, monopolar triangulation and grid convolution
comparators.procedure: Proposed competent author-method comparison after dependency/callgraph, defaults, mean/median template and fixed target-independent attempts are qualified. Truth-conditioned retry behavior, if active, must be separate historical diagnostic.

nuisance_controls: Absolute error alongside stability; constant centroid can have zero drift and poor localization.
Shared predeclared corruption masks/seeds,50 µV noise distinguished from biological failure.
Channel permutation with geometry fixed; destroyed waveforms retaining metadata; frozen development mean coordinate.
Coordinate-axis/voltage-unit consistency and complete nearest-contact proxy/index provenance.
evaluation.uncertainty: Paired verified independent group differences; report all small-cohort groups and use bootstrap only when group count supports it. No spike-level confidence inflation.
evaluation.failure_policy: Any missing/extra/duplicate/invalid required row or changed programme identity is a protocol failure with no headline score. Keep complete requested denominators and valid-row diagnostics; never score only the successful intersection.

implementation.scorer_target: Strict < 50 µm error against approximate nearest-contact proxy over all 880 cases, with group-balanced spike/template scores and estimator stability. This is an identified-source measurement target, not paper-table reconstruction.
implementation.delivered_scope: Complete normalized-input projection/scorer and geometry-only negative control programme. Generated controls distinguish hierarchical aggregation from cell/spike pooling.
missing: Authenticate original archive/normalizer, gain/geometry/axes, proxy workbook convention and recording/animal joins.
Qualify full target-independent COM/MT/GC references and official dependency/callgraph closure.
Deliver candidate-facing waveform execution/investigation and protected reference custody.
implementation.execution_evidence: Existing invented 880-case controls exercise source projection, centroid geometry reads, grouped arithmetic and error-versus-stability counterexamples. They are not authentic localization/model results.

direct_observation.representation: Potential numeric or spatial waveform display for one identified source.
direct_observation.boundary: Would need complete waveform/geometry representation; current native/program claim cannot be inferred from scoring outputs.
missing: Complete direct observation packet and no-tools response interface.

typed_viewer.representation: A probe-geometry-linked multichannel waveform viewer is scientifically plausible.
typed_viewer.boundary: Restrict to permitted signals and geometry; never show nearest-contact target or private degradation mask.
missing: Typed waveform/geometry actions and target-free renderer.

tool_assisted.representation: Per-case waveform localization with fixed scientific tools.
tool_assisted.boundary: Same inputs/compute; no target-conditioned retries or author cached answers.
missing: Actual investigator transport, admitted waveform methods and runtime boundary.

frozen_program.representation: Existing frozen-program hash submission ABI and executable geometry-centroid programme.
frozen_program.boundary: The supplied centroid programme is a fixed geometry-only negative-control producer. It supplies no candidate module/callback or frozen participant lifecycle.
missing: Competent waveform programmes, authentic normalized inputs and qualified executor.
A genuine candidate executable/predictor lifecycle with frozen input scope and captured complete outputs. Fixed reference or negative-control source alone is insufficient.

evidence.supports: Preserved source-backed registration, prospective scientific design and original exposure limitations; current implementation changes are described separately.
validate_neural/project/score enforce 880 cases, complete requests, nearest_contact_proxy coordinates and strict < 50 µm group-balanced accuracy with separate template stability.
produce reads all unique probe geometry bodies only and outputs arithmetic centroid for every spike/template; competent_reference=False.
Complete 11-cell×16-condition×5-realization source scope and generated-control versus authentic qualification limits.

evidence.locator: Experimental localization and degradation methods, audited in original registration
evidence.supports: Selected paired extracellular/patch recordings, artificial channel corruption and strict 50 µm convention.
Author-derived 11 selected-pair archive, not all 43 original pairs.

evidence.locator: Pinned official algorithms and util_eval.py reviewed in original registration
evidence.supports: COM/triangulation/grid-convolution reference routes; missing dependency and truth-conditioned retry callgraph require qualification.

empirical_claims.historical_evidence: The inspected source carries construction and generated software-control evidence. No neural programme pilot among the four historical EEG/sleep attempts is attributed to this registration, and no model or human outcome is added here.
excluded_claims: Spike detection or exact biological soma coordinates.
Genuine in-vivo motion from drift relative to own undegraded estimate.
All 43 source pairs, population generalization or authentic chronic electrode failure.
Geometry-only centroid as competent neural understanding.

summary: Update scorer target from vague spatial ground truth to exact delivered nearest-contact proxy and full 880-case hierarchy.
Distinguish a concrete geometry-only programme control from absent competent waveform methods.
Keep accuracy and stability separate and prevent truth-assisted retry/native-parity overclaims.
Fixed reference/negative-control execution is recorded as comparator capability, not a delivered frozen participant mode.
revision.source_review: Reused the preserved registration primary-source audit and inspected the listed actual implementation paths. No authentic numerical payload or protected label was opened; no model was run.
